queryOutcomes: English and Assamese first-party discovery queries were executed and recorded in the city packet. Official Hojai District and Assam ILRMS pages established the land-record custodian context. The current Bhunaksha JavaScript was fetched and inspected to derive the public routes.
requestOutcomes: District code 36, Hojai circle code 360109, and Hojai Town No. 1 code 360109010520001 were resolved through public requests. The parcel_info route returned three HTTP 200 MultiPolygon records in EPSG:32646. They were converted to EPSG:4326 and retained with exactly one canonical native identity property each.
scopeLimits: Only Hojai Town No. 1 was sampled; Town Nos. 2 and 3 and the wider municipality/district were not qualified.
The WUP point was preserved exactly and used only as a locator; it was not shifted and no exact-point parcel hit was asserted.
Three polygons are evidence of a working bounded public route, not evidence of citywide completeness or legal survey accuracy.
Runtime admission remains held pending independent serial review.
nativeIdentityProvenance: The source response supplied uniqueId values distinct from the dag number and location code. Those uniqueId values are retained as GeoJSON properties.id; locationCode, dag numbers, and source field mapping remain only in city/service-review metadata.
uncertainty: No absence inference is made from the WUP point falling outside the retained sample. Service coverage, completeness, stability, legal status of displayed geometry, and municipal boundary correspondence remain unverified.
